text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I prepared a delicious present that 
Spe-chan's sure to love!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Delicious!? ...That means it's food! Waah, 
thank you--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Now, guess what food it is! Here's a hint— 
It's a tropical fruit that I love too~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan's favorite tropical fruit... 
Could it be... mangoes, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Ah!? That's right! If we're talking about 
my favorite foods in a tropical country, 
mango totally fits the bill too!?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mangoes are so velvety... Rich, sweet, and 
tangy... simply delicious~...♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What do I do... I can't bring myself 
to tell her it's not a mango... But... 
but...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, Spe-chan! The present is... a 
banana!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, bananas! Fufu, choco-bananas, banana 
cake, smoothies, and banana mousse! I'm so 
happy~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Bananas are great because you can wolf 
them down whenever you're feeling hungry! 
Ah, just thinking about it is making me 
starve~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness...! Oh, Spe-chan, I love 
you so much!!
